import sys

def max_outside_word(text):
    parts = text.split('_')
    return max((len(p) for p in parts), default=0)

def count_inside_words(text):
    parts = text.split('_')
    return sum(1 for p in parts if p != '')

def main():
    tokens = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(tokens[0])
    s = tokens[1]
    open_parenthesis = False
    buffer = []
    max_outside = 0
    nbr_inside = 0
    for c in s:
        if c == '(':
            if not open_parenthesis:
                text = ''.join(buffer)
                max_outside = max(max_outside, max_outside_word(text))
            open_parenthesis = True
            buffer = []
        elif c == ')':
            open_parenthesis = False
            text = ''.join(buffer)
            nbr_inside += count_inside_words(text)
            buffer = []
        else:
            buffer.append(c)
    text = ''.join(buffer)
    max_outside = max(max_outside, max_outside_word(text))
    print(f"{max_outside} {nbr_inside}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
